Embrace the confidence of nourished lips with our Lip Love Lip Mask. Infused with luscious ingredients like shea butter and jojoba oil, this lip mask works its charm in just a few hours. From dull to delicious, this Mask provides intense hydration, locks in moisture, repairs and restores, softens, and smoothes lips - thanks to the goodness of shea butter and hyaluronic acid.
Simply apply a generous coat any time of the day, and let it do its lip-loving wonders. The rich, velvety texture melts onto your lips, leaving them feeling plump and moisturized. Just scoop, glide, and revive. It's all about soft lips, loud impact indeed.
Indulge in the ultimate lip care ritual that banishes dullness, heals dryness, and unveils lips that are irresistibly soft and supple. Are you ready to experience lip perfection? Try our lip mask today and let your lips shine like never before.
Get your hands on the showstopper's secret to the ultimate lip lovin' ritual regime today!

details.description:
Bring out the mirrors...let the world know that soft luscious lips are here to stay with the new Lakmé Lip Scrub! It is the perfect kick-starter for the most luxurious lip care regime of every diva. Infused with the gentlest exfoliating crystals, it leaves the lips smoother, like never before. The scrub buffs and exfoliates the dead skin away, making way for soft luscious lips dripping with charm.
You’re bound to fall in lip love with the ultra-comfortable texture and the nourishing goodness of moisturizing butters. You never have to worry about chapped-flaky lips, as this scrub buffs away the lips to make them red carpet ready. Bold or soft, matte or gloss, every lipstick will glide like magic on your lips due to the enriching properties of jojoba oil, sweet almond oil, sugar, shea butter, cocoa butter, and hyaluronic acid.
Every diva’s best-kept secret, Pair it with the Lakme Lip Mask to keep up the lip love. All you must do is gently exfoliate in a circular motion, rinse, and moisture like you mean it...and voila! never worry about dry and dull lips ever again. Get ready for plump, smooth, and luscious lips for the perfect pout.
